text: Decomposed into 7 children (PKIX-emf1.1-.7). Key correction: parent description's claim that pyca PolicyBuilder supports CRLs is incorrect (verified against cryptography 48.0.0 — PolicyBuilder has no revocation API). PKIX-emf1.4 documents the situation and is human-bound. Children .1 is the data-type plumbing (safe, fully scoped). .2 wires pkix-path oracle. .3 wires OpenSSL oracle. .5 and .6 wire PKITS / pem-tree / limbo loaders. .7 regenerates baseline. Order: .1 must land first; .2 .3 .5 .6 can land in parallel after .1; .7 last.
